concept: A radiant sun pavilion with confident warm forms and a generous theatrical glow.
floor: One continuous smooth saffron-gold stone floor across the full top face, with broad sun-warmed shading and no grass, tiles, symbols, rings, or repeated pattern.
main_structure: One bold sun-mane-inspired pavilion at the rear, built from a large amber arch and seven oversized rounded ray slabs around a warm luminous disc.
side_props: three large amber fan-leaf sculptures on the upper-left edge
one broad cream sun bench and one coral urn on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous rounded amber stone wall with broad cream cap blocks

lighting: soft radiant afternoon light with one broad warm rear glow
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open saffron-stone floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, lion, animal, face, egg, or familiar baked into the bitmap
zodiac glyph, constellation, text, center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, watermark, external shadow, sparks, tiny rays, cracks, specks, or dense clutter
